rules: Assess meaning in context, not exact wording
Accept appropriate short replies, names, place names, and loanwords
English help requests are unscored; English-only task answers are unsuccessful target-language attempts
Do not invent grammar scores for English-only or unassessable replies
Separate true errors from optional style suggestions
Require learner message ID and exact evidence span for goal completion
Do not count bee text as learner evidence
Assisted completion is distinct from independent mastery
An understandable minor grammar error need not block goal completion
No infrastructure failure may penalise the learner

planner: Respond to relevant learner questions before advancing
Ask one main question at a time
Keep bee facts consistent throughout the session
Offer opportunities for pending goals without revealing answers
Use Tagalog for chat and English for optional explanations
Permit fictional personal details and respect refusal to disclose
sessionScore: Average first assessable attempts per task; English-only unsuccessful task attempts count zero; help and technical errors excluded; retries reported separately; no attempts means not_scored
runtimeRequirements: Authenticate users and verify session ownership
Server loads trusted missions and policy
Validate structured model output and semantic invariants
Server calculates scores; never trust client-supplied scores
Use idempotency keys and expected session revisions
Only one in-flight turn per session
Limit input, history size, generation tokens, concurrency, and requests
Per-user and global quota guards; no paid fallback
Render messages as text, not raw HTML
API key only in server configuration; never in GitHub or browser
Minimise logs and support deletion and retention policies
